title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 7 (Florence Lake Forest Service Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Florence Lake Forest Service Road
7 That portion of M.U. 2-8 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of Florence Lake Forest Service Road from the northern boundary of the District of Mission northerly to the terminus of Florence Lake Forest Service Road, including any spur roads.
